blocks.zh: Section 2: Test Methods Part 2 & Acceptance Criteria | 試驗方法（二）與接受標準
blocks.en: Section 2: Test Methods Part 2 & Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握矽膠（Silica Gel）的試劑製備方法，包括草酸鹽試液（Oxalic acid TS）與鉬酸銨試液（Ammonium molybdate TS）的配製及穩定性要求
blocks.en: Master the reagent preparation methods for silica gel, including the preparation and stability requirements of Oxalic acid TS and Ammonium molybdate TS

blocks.zh: 理解除臭吸附劑（Odor Adsorbent）中活性碳的丁烷活性（Butane Activity）測試原理、操作程序及安全注意事項
blocks.en: Understand the principle, procedure, and safety precautions of the Butane Activity test for activated carbon as an odor adsorbent

blocks.zh: 掌握丁烷活性的計算公式，並能判斷活性碳作為除臭劑的合規性（NLT 17.6%）
blocks.en: Master the butane activity calculation formula and be able to judge the compliance of activated carbon as an odor adsorbent (NLT 17.6%)

blocks.zh: 能整合 USP 〈670〉 的全章接受標準（Acceptance Criteria）矩陣，快速比對各組件的規格要求
blocks.en: Be able to consolidate the acceptance criteria matrix for the whole USP <670> chapter and quickly compare the specification requirements of each component

blocks.zh: 認識 USP 〈670〉 的文件資訊、專家委員會聯絡機制及與 ASTM 標準的交叉引用
blocks.en: Become familiar with the document information of USP <670>, the expert committee contact mechanism, and the cross-references to ASTM standards

blocks.zh: Silica Gel — Test Solutions & Reagents | 矽膠試液配製
blocks.en: Silica Gel: Test Solutions & Reagents

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 鉬酸銨試液的矽酸鹽反應機制
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Silicate Reaction Mechanism of Ammonium Molybdate TS

blocks.zh: 矽膠鑑別的化學原理：矽酸根離子（SiO₄⁴⁻）在酸性條件下與鉬酸根（MoO₄²⁻）反應形成「矽鉬酸」（silicomolybdic acid，H₄SiMo₁₂O₄₀），呈現鮮豔的深黃色。這是矽元素的特異性顯色反應。
blocks.en: Chemistry of silica gel identification: Under acidic conditions, silicate ions (SiO₄⁴⁻) react with molybdate (MoO₄²⁻) to form "silicomolybdic acid" (H₄SiMo₁₂O₄₀), giving a vivid deep yellow color. This is a color reaction specific to silicon.

blocks.zh: 試液穩定性的驗證測試：USP 要求在使用前「以磷酸二鈉 TS 驗證——若不立即或微溫後形成黃色沉澱，則試液無效」。這是因為鉬酸銨試液放置後可能還原或分解，導致顯色能力下降。同理，磷酸根也能與鉬酸銨形成類似黃色沉澱（磷鉬酸），此反應作為試液活性的代理指標。
blocks.en: Verification test for solution stability: Before use, USP requires "verification with dibasic sodium phosphate TS: if a yellow precipitate does not form immediately or after gentle warming, the solution is not suitable". This is because ammonium molybdate TS may be reduced or decompose on standing, reducing its color-forming ability. Likewise, phosphate also forms a similar yellow precipitate with ammonium molybdate (phosphomolybdate), and this reaction serves as a surrogate indicator of the solution's activity.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 試液管理的 GMP 意涵
blocks.en: Key Notes: GMP Implications of Solution Management

blocks.zh: 「需避光保存，若出現沉澱只用澄清液」：鉬酸銨在光照和氧化條件下容易還原為深藍色的鉬藍（MoO₂），失去黃色顯色功能。這個配製和儲存要求直接影響試驗結果的可靠性。
blocks.en: "Protect from light, and if a precipitate forms use only the clear solution": Under light and oxidizing conditions, ammonium molybdate is easily reduced to dark blue molybdenum blue (MoO₂) and loses its yellow color-forming function. This preparation and storage requirement directly affects the reliability of the test results.

blocks.zh: GMP 良好文件規範（GDocP）要求：所有實驗室試液必須有：配製日期、有效期、配製人員簽名、儲存條件。鉬酸銨試液的「48 小時靜置後才能使用」是 USP 規定的必要程序，不可縮短。品保稽查時，試液配製記錄是重點查核項目。
blocks.en: Good documentation practice (GDocP) requirements under GMP: All laboratory solutions must have a preparation date, expiry date, preparer's signature, and storage conditions. The "48-hour standing period before use" for ammonium molybdate TS is a required procedure under USP and must not be shortened. During QA audits, solution preparation records are a key item checked.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 試液就像「有效期食材」
blocks.en: Analogy: Test Solutions Are Like "Perishable Ingredients"

blocks.zh: 鉬酸銨試液就像需要「熟成」的食材（如陳醋、熟成乳酪）——剛配好不能用，必須靜置 48 小時讓化學平衡建立。但「過期」後又不能用，需要重新配製。而且它怕光，就像橄欖油怕光氧化一樣。
blocks.en: Ammonium molybdate TS is like an ingredient that needs "maturing" (such as aged vinegar or matured cheese): it cannot be used as soon as it is made and must stand for 48 hours to let the chemical equilibrium establish itself. But once it "expires" it cannot be used and must be prepared again. It is also light-sensitive, just as olive oil is vulnerable to photo-oxidation.

blocks.zh: 在實驗室管理中，這類試液需要專人負責定期製備和效期管理，是品保稽查常見的查核點。
blocks.en: In laboratory management, such solutions need a designated person responsible for regular preparation and expiry control, and this is a common audit check point in QA inspections.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果鉬酸銨試液放置一段時間後變成藍色，這代表發生了什麼化學變化？應如何處置？
blocks.en: If ammonium molybdate TS turns blue after standing for a period, what chemical change has occurred? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 在正式分析前需要「驗證試液活性」（用磷酸二鈉 TS 檢查），而其他一般試液不需要類似的驗證步驟？
blocks.en: Why does USP require "verifying solution activity" (checking with dibasic sodium phosphate TS) before the actual analysis, while other general solutions need no similar verification step?

blocks.zh: 草酸鹽試液（Oxalic acid TS）用於多個鈣鹽沉澱程序，在鈣的定量分析中，草酸鈣沉澱法有什麼優缺點（相比 EDTA 滴定法）？
blocks.en: Oxalic acid TS is used in several calcium salt precipitation procedures. In the quantitative analysis of calcium, what are the advantages and disadvantages of the calcium oxalate precipitation method (compared with EDTA titration)?

blocks.zh: Odor Adsorbent — Carbon, Activated (VOC & Butane Activity) | 除臭吸附劑：活性碳丁烷活性試驗
blocks.en: Odor Adsorbent: Carbon, Activated (VOC & Butane Activity)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 丁烷活性的科學原理
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Scientific Principle of Butane Activity

blocks.zh: Butane Activity（丁烷活性）：用正丁烷（n-C₄H₁₀）作為代理分子，測量活性碳對揮發性有機物（VOC）的吸附能力。丁烷分子（動力學直徑約 4.3 Å）能進入活性碳的中孔（mesopores，2–50 nm）和大孔（macropores，>50 nm），代表活性碳對一般 VOC 的整體吸附效能。
blocks.en: Butane Activity: Uses n-butane (n-C₄H₁₀) as a surrogate molecule to measure the adsorption capacity of activated carbon for volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The butane molecule (kinetic diameter about 4.3 Å) can enter the mesopores (2–50 nm) and macropores (>50 nm) of the activated carbon, and so represents the overall adsorption performance of the activated carbon for VOCs in general.

blocks.zh: 為什麼用「體積」而非「重量」取樣（16.70 ± 0.05 mL）？因為不同批次的活性碳密度可能有差異。使用固定體積（而非固定重量）確保每次測試的床層高度一致，使流速和接觸時間可重複，從而得到可比較的測試結果。
blocks.en: Why sample by "volume" rather than "weight" (16.70 ± 0.05 mL)? Because the density of activated carbon can differ between batches. Using a fixed volume (rather than a fixed weight) ensures the same bed height in every test, so that flow rate and contact time are reproducible and the test results are comparable.

blocks.zh: ASTM 標準交叉引用：此測試方法基於 ASTM D5742-95「活性碳丁烷活性標準測試方法」。USP 直接採納 ASTM 行業標準，顯示兩大標準體系的協調一致。
blocks.en: Cross-reference to ASTM standards: This test method is based on ASTM D5742-95, "Standard Test Method for Determination of Butane Activity of Activated Carbon". USP directly adopts this ASTM industry standard, showing the harmonization of the two standards systems.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — 丁烷活性計算
blocks.en: Formula: Butane Activity Calculation

blocks.zh:
丁烷活性計算：

% Butane Activity = [(D − C) / (C − M)] × 100

D = 吸附飽和後的（碳 + 管 + 塞）重量 (g)
C = 吸附前的（碳 + 管 + 塞）重量 (g)
M = 空管 + 塞的重量（去皮重）(g)

分子：D − C = 吸附的丁烷質量
分母：C − M = 活性碳樣品本身的質量

驗收標準：NLT 17.6%

計算範例：
M = 28.50 g（空管 + 塞）
C = 42.35 g（碳 + 管 + 塞，吸附前）
D = 44.78 g（飽和後）

碳質量 = C − M = 42.35 − 28.50 = 13.85 g
吸附丁烷 = D − C = 44.78 − 42.35 = 2.43 g
% BA = (2.43 / 13.85) × 100 = 17.55%
→ 不合格（NLT 17.6%，差 0.05%）
blocks.en:
Butane activity calculation:

% Butane Activity = [(D − C) / (C − M)] × 100

D = weight of (carbon + tube + plug) after adsorption to saturation (g)
C = weight of (carbon + tube + plug) before adsorption (g)
M = weight of the empty tube + plug (tare weight) (g)

Numerator: D − C = mass of butane adsorbed
Denominator: C − M = mass of the activated carbon sample itself

Acceptance criterion: NLT 17.6%

Calculation example:
M = 28.50 g (empty tube + plug)
C = 42.35 g (carbon + tube + plug, before adsorption)
D = 44.78 g (after saturation)

Carbon mass = C − M = 42.35 − 28.50 = 13.85 g
Butane adsorbed = D − C = 44.78 − 42.35 = 2.43 g
% BA = (2.43 / 13.85) × 100 = 17.55%
→ Fails (NLT 17.6%, short by 0.05%)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 丁烷活性就像「海綿吸油測試」
blocks.en: Analogy: Butane Activity Is Like a "Sponge Oil-Absorption Test"

blocks.zh: 丁烷活性測試就像把廚房海綿放在油脂環境中，測試它能吸收幾倍重量的油脂。海綿的「孔隙結構」決定了其吸油能力，就像活性碳的孔徑結構決定其 VOC 吸附能力。
blocks.en: The butane activity test is like placing a kitchen sponge in an oily environment to see how many times its own weight in oil it can absorb. The "pore structure" of the sponge determines its oil absorption capacity, just as the pore size structure of activated carbon determines its VOC adsorption capacity.

blocks.zh: 測試用「固定體積（16.70 mL）」，就像每次測試都用「固定大小的海綿塊」——保持幾何形狀一致才能公平比較不同品牌海綿的吸油能力。10 分鐘間隔重複測試直到「吸飽」（重量不變）的設計，確保測量到真正的吸附容量上限。
blocks.en: Testing with a "fixed volume (16.70 mL)" is like using a "fixed-size piece of sponge" every time: only by keeping the geometry consistent can the oil absorption of different sponge brands be compared fairly. The design of repeating the test at 10-minute intervals until it is "saturated" (weight no longer changes) ensures that the true upper limit of adsorption capacity is measured.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 安全性是此測試的最大挑戰
blocks.en: Key Notes: Safety Is the Biggest Challenge of This Test

blocks.zh: n-Butane 的危害：高度易燃（LEL：1.8%）、可作為麻醉劑、可導致室顫（ventricular fibrillation）和窒息。USP 特別以 [Caution] 標示，要求在通風橙中進行，並遠離點火源。
blocks.en: Hazards of n-butane: Highly flammable (LEL: 1.8%), can act as an anesthetic, and can cause ventricular fibrillation and asphyxiation. USP specifically flags it with a [Caution] and requires work in a fume hood and away from ignition sources.

blocks.zh: 實驗室安全預防措施：
blocks.en: Laboratory safety precautions:

blocks.zh: 必須在通風良好的排煙罩（fume hood）中進行
blocks.en: Must be carried out in a well-ventilated fume hood

blocks.zh: 禁止附近有明火或電氣火花
blocks.en: No open flames or electrical sparks nearby

blocks.zh: 需準備 CO₂ 或乾粉滅火器
blocks.en: A CO₂ or dry powder fire extinguisher must be available

blocks.zh: 1.9 m 熱交換盤管確保丁烷在進入樣品前達到水浴溫度（25°C），避免溫度不均導致結果偏差
blocks.en: The 1.9 m heat exchange coil ensures the butane reaches the water bath temperature (25°C) before entering the sample, avoiding result bias caused by uneven temperature

blocks.zh: 2024 年加速修訂的意義：丁烷活性下限從之前的版本更新至 NLT 17.6%（使用 ▲ 符號標示修訂位置），表示 USP 專家委員會根據最新行業實踐強化了規格要求。
blocks.en: Significance of the accelerated 2024 revision: The lower limit for butane activity was updated from the previous version to NLT 17.6% (with the revision location marked by the ▲ symbol), indicating that the USP expert committee tightened the specification in line with the latest industry practice.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶要求你評估一款新的活性碳乾燥劑是否可同時作為除臭劑使用。你收到供應商提供的 CoA，丁烷活性 = 18.2%，水萃取物 = 3.5%，LOD = 4.1%，As = 7 ppm，Pb = 10 ppm。
blocks.en: A CDMO client asks you to assess whether a new activated carbon desiccant can also be used as an odor adsorbent. You receive the supplier's CoA: butane activity = 18.2%, water extractables = 3.5%, LOD = 4.1%, As = 7 ppm, Pb = 10 ppm.

blocks.zh: 評估：
blocks.en: Assessment:
Butane activity 18.2% ≥ NLT 17.6% ✓

blocks.zh: 水萃取物 3.5% ≤ NMT 5.0% ✓
blocks.en: Water extractables 3.5% ≤ NMT 5.0% ✓

blocks.zh: 尚需確認：ROI（≤5.0%）、高芳烴、吸附容量（≥21% at 80% RH）
blocks.en: Still to be confirmed: ROI (≤5.0%), higher aromatic hydrocarbons, adsorption capacity (≥21% at 80% RH)

blocks.zh: 此材料初步符合 USP 〈670〉 要求，可作為乾燥劑兼除臭劑雙重用途使用。
blocks.en: On a preliminary basis this material meets the USP <670> requirements and can be used for the dual purpose of desiccant and odor adsorbent.

blocks.zh: 為什麼丁烷活性測試要使用「16.70 ± 0.05 mL 的體積」而不是「固定重量（如 10.0 g）」取樣？
blocks.en: Why does the butane activity test use a sample "volume of 16.70 ± 0.05 mL" rather than a "fixed weight (such as 10.0 g)"?

blocks.zh: 丁烷活性的合規標準是「NLT 17.6%」（限制最低值），而不是設上限，這說明了什麼？
blocks.en: The butane activity compliance criterion is "NLT 17.6%" (a minimum) rather than an upper limit. What does this tell us?

blocks.zh: 一個廠商宣稱他的活性碳丁烷活性是 25%，遠超規格，但水萃取物是 6%（超過 5% 上限）。這批材料能否使用？為什麼？
blocks.en: A vendor claims that the butane activity of his activated carbon is 25%, far above the specification, but the water extractables are 6% (above the 5% upper limit). Can this batch be used? Why?

blocks.zh: Comprehensive Acceptance Criteria Summary | 完整接受標準彙整
blocks.en: Comprehensive Acceptance Criteria Summary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — ASTM 與 USP 的協調
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Harmonization of ASTM and USP

blocks.zh: USP 〈670〉 引用了多個 ASTM 標準：
blocks.en: USP <670> cites several ASTM standards:

blocks.zh: ASTM D276：紡織纖維鑑別（棉、嫘縈、聚酯）
blocks.en: ASTM D276: Identification of textile fibers (cotton, rayon, polyester)

blocks.zh: ASTM D5745：活性碳丁烷活性測定（除臭劑測試）
blocks.en: ASTM D5745: Determination of butane activity of activated carbon (odor adsorbent test)

blocks.zh: ASTM D5742-95：活性碳丁烷活性的較早版本標準
blocks.en: ASTM D5742-95: The earlier version of the standard for butane activity of activated carbon

blocks.zh: 這種跨標準引用反映了製藥行業的開放性——USP 不重複制定已有業界標準的測試方法，而是直接引用，並在必要時（如藥品安全考量）新增或強化要求。這大幅降低了標準制定成本，也確保了方法的行業認可度。
blocks.en: This cross-referencing reflects the openness of the pharmaceutical industry: USP does not rewrite test methods for which industry standards already exist, but cites them directly and, where necessary (for example for drug safety reasons), adds or strengthens requirements. This greatly reduces the cost of standard setting and also ensures the methods are recognized by industry.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 供應商設備的「Suitable」靈活性
blocks.en: Key Notes: Flexibility of "Suitable" Equipment

blocks.zh: USP 中多次出現「A suitable [equipment]...may be used」（第 4–9 腳注），這是 USP 的重要彈性設計：
blocks.en: "A suitable [equipment]... may be used" appears many times in USP (footnotes 4–9), and this is an important flexibility in the design of USP:

blocks.zh: 不強制使用特定廠牌的儀器
blocks.en: Use of a specific brand of instrument is not mandatory

blocks.zh: 企業可使用任何能達到相同效果的合適設備
blocks.en: Companies may use any suitable equipment that achieves the same result

blocks.zh: 但必須驗證所使用設備的適用性（方法驗證）
blocks.en: But the suitability of the equipment used must be demonstrated (method validation)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 實驗室而言，更換設備時需要評估性能是否等效，並記錄評估過程，這是法規合規的核心要求。
blocks.en: For a CDMO laboratory, when equipment is changed, the equivalence of performance must be evaluated and the evaluation documented; this is a core regulatory compliance requirement.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 腳注是「技術支援電話號碼」
blocks.en: Analogy: Footnotes Are the "Technical Support Phone Number"

blocks.zh: USP 章節的腳注就像使用說明書末頁的「技術支援聯絡資訊」——正文告訴你「如何做」，腳注告訴你「去哪裡買材料/設備」、「需要更多資訊去哪查」。
blocks.en: The footnotes of a USP chapter are like the "technical support contact information" on the last page of an instruction manual: the main text tells you "how to do it", while the footnotes tell you "where to buy the materials/equipment" and "where to look for more information".

blocks.zh: 「Desmond G. Hunt, Principal Scientific Liaison」就是 USP 〈670〉 的技術窗口人員——如果對章節內容有疑問，他是 FAQ 之外的最後聯繫管道。對法規諮詢工作而言，這個資訊極其寶貴。
blocks.en: "Desmond G. Hunt, Principal Scientific Liaison" is the technical contact for USP <670>: if you have questions about the chapter content, he is the last point of contact beyond the FAQ. For regulatory consulting work, this information is extremely valuable.

blocks.zh: Master Acceptance Criteria Table | 全章接受標準速查表
blocks.en: Master Acceptance Criteria Table

blocks.zh: 原文內容 — Consolidated Acceptance Criteria
blocks.en: Original Text: Consolidated Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 速查表的決策應用
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Using the Quick-Reference Table in Decisions

blocks.zh: 如何使用這張表格進行供應商評估：
blocks.en: How to use this table for supplier evaluation:

blocks.zh: Step 1：確認乾燥劑類型（6 種中的哪一種）
blocks.en: Step 1: Confirm the desiccant type (which of the 6)

blocks.zh: Step 2：對照表格找出所有強制規格
blocks.en: Step 2: Find all mandatory specifications in the table

blocks.zh: Step 3：要求供應商提供每個規格項目的 CoA 數據
blocks.en: Step 3: Ask the supplier for CoA data for each specification item

blocks.zh: Step 4：確認 CoA 中的測試方法是否符合 USP 規定（如重金屬用 〈233〉 方法）
blocks.en: Step 4: Confirm that the test methods in the CoA comply with USP (for example, heavy metals by the <233> method)

blocks.zh: Step 5：對於有效期要求的測試（如開瓶後立即測試），核查供應商的品管程序
blocks.en: Step 5: For tests with time requirements (such as testing immediately after opening the bottle), check the supplier's quality control procedures

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 各乾燥劑的獨特規格要點
blocks.en: Key Notes: Distinctive Specification Points of Each Desiccant

blocks.zh: 需要特別注意的差異點：
blocks.en: Points of difference that need particular attention:

blocks.zh: CaO 的鉛限度（NMT 2 mg/kg）是所有乾燥劑中最嚴格的，幾乎是 CaCl₂（5 ppm）的一半
blocks.en: The lead limit for CaO (NMT 2 mg/kg) is the strictest of all desiccants, almost half that of CaCl₂ (5 ppm)

blocks.zh: CaO 的氟化物限度（NMT 0.015%）比 CaCl₂（NMT 0.004%）寬鬆 3.75 倍
blocks.en: The fluoride limit for CaO (NMT 0.015%) is 3.75 times looser than that for CaCl₂ (NMT 0.004%)

blocks.zh: 分子篩的 LOD 在 575°——遠高於其他乾燥劑（105–145°），是唯一使用高溫 LOD 的乾燥劑
blocks.en: The LOD of molecular sieves is at 575°, far higher than for the other desiccants (105–145°), and it is the only desiccant that uses a high-temperature LOD

blocks.zh: 矽膠是唯一有 Assay（含量測定）要求的乾燥劑（NLT 94% SiO₂），其他乾燥劑只用鑑別而無含量規格
blocks.en: Silica gel is the only desiccant with an Assay requirement (NLT 94% SiO₂); the others have only identification and no content specification

blocks.zh: 活性碳是唯一既測量有機污染物（高芳烴、水萃取物）又測量無機污染物（重金屬）的乾燥劑
blocks.en: Activated carbon is the only desiccant that measures both organic contaminants (higher aromatic hydrocarbons, water extractables) and inorganic contaminants (heavy metals)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 法規框架是「多層濾網」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Regulatory Framework Is a "Multi-Layer Filter"

blocks.zh: USP 〈670〉 的驗收標準體系就像一套多層濾網：第一層過濾（鑑別試驗）確認是正確的材料；第二層（純度/雜質測試）確保材料足夠純淨；第三層（功能測試）驗證材料有足夠的工作能力。
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria system of USP <670> is like a multi-layer filter: the first layer (identification tests) confirms it is the right material; the second layer (purity/impurity tests) ensures the material is sufficiently pure; the third layer (functional tests) verifies that the material has sufficient working capacity.

blocks.zh: 這三層缺一不可：只通過鑑別但含量不足的乾燥劑不能保護藥品；只通過含量但重金屬超標的乾燥劑可能危害患者。
blocks.en: None of the three layers can be omitted: a desiccant that passes identification but has insufficient content cannot protect the drug product; a desiccant that passes content but exceeds heavy metal limits may harm patients.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — CDMO 採購審計場景
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Procurement Audit Scenario

blocks.zh: 假設你負責審計一個乾燥劑供應商，供應分子篩（4A 型）用於你的口服固體劑型產品包裝。以下是你的稽查清單（基於 USP 〈670〉）：
blocks.en: Suppose you are responsible for auditing a desiccant supplier that supplies molecular sieves (type 4A) for the packaging of your oral solid dosage form product. The following is your audit checklist (based on USP <670>):

blocks.zh: 鑑別 A（矽酸殘留）和鑑別 B（鋁的兩性沉澱）是否有最近 1 年內的測試記錄？
blocks.en: Are there test records within the last 1 year for Identification A (silicic acid residue) and Identification B (amphoteric precipitation of aluminum)?

blocks.zh: LOD 是否在 575 ± 25°（而非普通 105°）測試，結果 ≤4.5%？
blocks.en: Is the LOD tested at 575 ± 25° (rather than the ordinary 105°), with results ≤4.5%?

blocks.zh: 吸附容量是否同時在 40% RH（≥15%）和 80% RH（≥16.5%）兩個條件下測試？
blocks.en: Is the adsorption capacity tested under both 40% RH (≥15%) and 80% RH (≥16.5%)?

blocks.zh: 鉛含量（≤5 ppm）是否使用 USP 〈233〉 方法，且標準品在 3 天內配製？
blocks.en: Is the lead content (≤5 ppm) determined using the USP <233> method, with the standard prepared within 3 days?

blocks.zh: pH 是否在 6.5–12 範圍內（200 mg/mL CO₂-free water）？
blocks.en: Is the pH within the range 6.5–12 (200 mg/mL in CO₂-free water)?

blocks.zh: 吸附容量測試記錄是否包含原始稱重數據和平衡判定（≤3 mg/g 差值）的文件？
blocks.en: Do the adsorption capacity test records include the raw weighing data and documentation of the equilibrium criterion (≤3 mg/g difference)?

blocks.zh: 從速查表可以看出，膨潤土和分子篩都需要在兩個濕度條件下測試吸附容量，但矽膠的 40% RH 規格（NLT 19%）卻比 80% RH（NLT 27%）低很多，這說明了矽膠吸濕的什麼特性？
blocks.en: The quick-reference table shows that bentonite and molecular sieves must both be tested for adsorption capacity at two humidity conditions, but the 40% RH specification for silica gel (NLT 19%) is much lower than its 80% RH specification (NLT 27%). What does this say about the moisture absorption behavior of silica gel?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 對活性碳設有「水萃取物 NMT 5%」的限制，而對其他乾燥劑沒有類似要求？
blocks.en: Why does USP set a "water extractables NMT 5%" limit for activated carbon but no similar requirement for the other desiccants?

blocks.zh: 矽膠的 Assay 需要 NLT 94% SiO₂，若某批矽膠 SiO₂ 只有 91%，其餘 9% 可能是什麼成分？這對藥品包裝有什麼風險？
blocks.en: The Assay of silica gel requires NLT 94% SiO₂. If a batch of silica gel has only 91% SiO₂, what might the remaining 9% be? What risks does this pose to the drug product packaging?

blocks.zh: 全章重點回顧 Complete Chapter Summary — USP 〈670〉 Auxiliary Packaging Components
blocks.en: Complete Chapter Summary: USP <670> Auxiliary Packaging Components

blocks.zh: 鉬酸銨試液（Ammonium molybdate TS）：需 48 小時靜置後才能使用，須避光保存，使用前以磷酸二鈉 TS 驗證活性（黃色沉澱立即形成），是矽膠 SiO₂ 鑑別的特異性試液
blocks.en: Ammonium molybdate TS: Must stand for 48 hours before use, be protected from light, and be verified for activity with dibasic sodium phosphate TS before use (a yellow precipitate forms immediately); it is the specific reagent for the identification of SiO₂ in silica gel

blocks.zh: 除臭劑活性碳的丁烷活性測試：基於 ASTM D5742-95，用固定體積（16.70 mL）樣品，250 mL/min 丁烷流速，25°C 水浴，重複 10 分鐘間隔直到重量恒定（±0.02 g），計算公式 = [(D-C)/(C-M)] × 100，驗收標準 NLT 17.6%（2024 年更新）
blocks.en: Butane activity test for activated carbon as an odor adsorbent: Based on ASTM D5742-95, using a fixed volume (16.70 mL) of sample, a butane flow rate of 250 mL/min, and a 25°C water bath, repeated at 10-minute intervals until constant weight (±0.02 g); calculation formula = [(D-C)/(C-M)] × 100, acceptance criterion NLT 17.6% (updated in 2024)

blocks.zh: USP 〈670〉 與 ASTM 的雙重引用：ASTM D276（纖維鑑別）、D5745、D5742-95（丁烷活性），體現標準協調精神；「Suitable equipment may be used」原則賦予企業設備選擇彈性，但需方法驗證
blocks.en: Dual citation of USP <670> and ASTM: ASTM D276 (fiber identification), D5745, and D5742-95 (butane activity) reflect the spirit of standards harmonization; the principle that "suitable equipment may be used" gives companies flexibility in equipment selection, but method validation is required

blocks.zh: 全章最重要差異點：三種棉卷靠染色顏色區分（綠/藍綠/淡橙）；六種乾燥劑各有獨特 LOD 溫度（105°–575°）和吸附規格；活性碳作為除臭劑需額外通過丁烷活性測試；嫘縈棉卷警示明膠交叉鏈結風險
blocks.en: The most important differences across the chapter: The three coil types are distinguished by staining color (green / blue-green / light orange); the six desiccants each have their own LOD temperature (105°–575°) and adsorption specifications; activated carbon as an odor adsorbent must additionally pass the butane activity test; rayon coil carries a warning about the risk of gelatin cross-linking
